declaration.preface: Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd., an ICE Pharma company, is committed to maintaining the highest standards of ethical conduct, integrity, and compliance across all aspects of its business. As a responsible manufacturer of pharmaceutical ingredients, Raichem recognises that ethical behaviour is fundamental to sustaining trust with employees, customers, suppliers, regulators, and other stakeholders, and to supporting long-term business resilience. In alignment with the broader ICE Pharma sustainability strategy, the Ethical Conduct Policy establishes principles and expectations that guide decisions and behaviour throughout the organisation and its supply chain. This policy reinforces Raichem’s dedication to lawful and transparent operations, responsible business practices, and the continual promotion of ethical standards in every interaction and business relationship.
declaration.declaration: Raichem establishes this Ethical Conduct Policy to ensure that all business activities are conducted with integrity, fairness, and accountability. The Company requires employees, management, and business partners to comply with applicable laws, internal policies, and recognised standards of ethical conduct. Raichem maintains zero tolerance for bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, or any other unethical practices, and promotes a culture of transparency and responsible decision-making across all operations and business relationships.
declaration.scope: This Ethical Conduct Policy applies to all employees, contractual staff, consultants, and business partners of Raichem and governs conduct across all functions and operations, including manufacturing, quality assurance, supply chain activities, sales, and customer engagement. The policy also extends to interactions with vendors, suppliers, service providers, and other external stakeholders, ensuring that all business relationships are conducted in alignment with the Company’s values of integrity, transparency, and ethical responsibility.

focusAreas: Anti-Corruption: Prohibit bribery, kickbacks, and all forms of corrupt practices through clear standards, training, and enforcement.
Conflict of Interest: Disclose and manage any personal or financial interests that could affect business decisions.
Fraud Prevention: Detect and prevent fraud using internal controls, audits, and confidential reporting channels.
Anti-Money Laundering (AML): Comply with AML laws by monitoring transactions, identifying suspicious activities, and providing training.
Information Security: Safeguard confidential data through access controls, security measures, and awareness programs.
Responsible Use of Company Assets: Ensure assets are used responsibly, efficiently, and solely for legitimate business purposes.

Anti-Corruption: Maintain a zero-tolerance approach to bribery, kickbacks, or any form of corrupt practices in line with applicable laws and Company policies.
Promote a culture of integrity in which employees and business partners understand the obligation to reject bribery and unethical conduct.
Provide periodic anti-corruption training and guidance to employees and relevant third parties.
Encourage the reporting of suspected corruption through confidential reporting channels without fear of retaliation.
Conflict of Interest: Establish clear processes for identifying, disclosing, and managing actual or potential conflicts of interest in a fair and impartial manner.
Ensure that business decisions are objective, unbiased, and free from improper personal or financial influence.
Maintain transparency in relationships with suppliers, customers, and partners by documenting conflicts and mitigation measures.
Fraud Prevention: Implement internal controls, audits, and monitoring mechanisms to prevent, detect, and address fraudulent activities.
Encourage prompt reporting of suspected fraud or irregularities through confidential reporting mechanisms.
Investigate all reported incidents in a timely manner and take appropriate corrective or disciplinary actions.
Anti-Money Laundering (AML): Comply with all applicable anti-money laundering laws, regulations, and internal procedures to prevent misuse of Company operations.
Ensure employees are aware of AML obligations, including transaction monitoring and identification of suspicious activities.
Maintain accurate and complete records of transactions to support transparency and regulatory compliance.
Information Security: Safeguard confidential business, employee, and stakeholder information through appropriate access controls and cybersecurity measures.
Regularly assess and strengthen data protection practices to address evolving risks and regulatory requirements, ensuring secure handling, storage, and disposal of information.
Restrict access to sensitive information based on role-based and need-to-know principles.
Promote awareness of information security responsibilities through ongoing employee training.
Responsible Use of Company Assets: Ensure Company assets are used responsibly, ethically, and only for authorised business purposes.
Encourage employees to promptly report any suspected misuse, loss, or damage to Company assets.

policy.monitoring:
At Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd. Ethical Conduct practices are continuously enhanced to stay aligned with evolving regulations, industry standards, and emerging risks. A strong culture of integrity is embedded across all levels of the organization, ensuring transparency, accountability, and regulatory compliance.

Ongoing Training & Awareness: Raichem conducts regular ethics, anti-corruption, AML, fraud prevention, and data protection training for employees and relevant external stakeholders. Training programs are updated periodically to reflect regulatory changes, emerging risks, and lessons learned from internal reviews and incidents.

Risk Assessments & Independent Audits: Periodic ethics and compliance risk assessments are carried out to identify potential vulnerabilities related to corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, money laundering, and information security. Independent internal and external audits are used to validate controls, verify compliance, and recommend improvements.

Collaborative Compliance Engagement: Partnerships with internal and external stakeholders strengthen ethical standards and compliance through structured assessments, engagement, and continuous improvement actions.

Advanced Monitoring & Reporting Systems: The company maintains systems to monitor high-risk transactions, compliance indicators, incidents, and policy adherence. Key metrics are reviewed regularly by management to ensure early detection of risks, timely response, and continuous strengthening of controls.

Feedback & Transparency Culture: Raichem encourages open feedback, ethical dialogue, and reporting of concerns without fear of retaliation. Whistleblowing and grievance mechanisms are promoted actively, and aggregated findings and improvements are communicated transparently to reinforce trust and accountability.

Raichem Medicare Pvt. Ltd. maintains a zero-tolerance approach toward violations of its Ethical Conduct Policy. All suspected or confirmed breaches will be handled seriously, fairly, and in a timely manner to uphold the company’s values of integrity, transparency, and accountability.

Reporting Violations: All employees, contractors, and business partners are encouraged to report suspected or actual violations of this policy through designated confidential channels, including the Compliance function, HR, or the whistleblowing mechanism. Reports may be made anonymously where permitted by law and will be treated with strict confidentiality.

Investigation Process: All reported concerns are assessed and investigated promptly and objectively by the Compliance function, in coordination with Legal and HR where appropriate. Investigations are conducted fairly, respecting due process, confidentiality, and the rights of all parties involved.

Corrective Actions: Confirmed violations result in appropriate corrective and disciplinary actions, which may include process improvements, retraining, formal warnings, termination of employment or contracts, and, where required, legal action. Root causes are addressed to prevent recurrence.

Protection from Retaliation: Retaliation against any individual who reports concerns in good faith or participates in an investigation is strictly prohibited. Any act of retaliation will be treated as a serious policy violation and subject to disciplinary action.
policy.reviewMechanism: The Ethical Conduct Policy is reviewed annually by the Compliance Officer to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with legal and regulatory requirements. Updates may be made based on audit findings, changes in applicable laws, employee feedback, or evolving business practices. Any revisions are communicated to all employees, and necessary training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance.
